title: FONTANorm study: recording the current care situation and establishing standardized nationwide follow-up recommendations for patients with univentricular palliation
summary: There are currently no nationwide recommendations for the follow-up care of patients with Fontan circulation. The decisions on the selection and timing of the examinations carried out and the recommendations on everyday behavior therefore lie with the center or practice providing care. With our study, we would like to determine the current status of follow-up care for this patient group in order to subsequently develop a nationwide follow-up care strategy. Our aim is not only to identify possible gaps in care, but also to find out whether the recommendations made are being implemented by surveying patients.

interventions.name:
An online survey of patients who have undergone Fontan surgery and the doctors who care for them will be used to determine the current status of aftercare following Fontan surgery throughout Germany and to identify any existing gaps in care.
